verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents its own background automation: continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously on incoming data and write output to destinations. The Data Transfer Service schedules recurring load jobs, and Dataform schedules complex transformation workflows in BigQuery. missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-driven autonomous automations (data agents are documented only for interactive conversational analytics), explicit scheduled-query documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these automations running unattended.
